Audio credits

The public instructions use computer-generated recordings. Your account entries are not used to generate audio. These prototype voices have not yet passed fluent-speaker comprehension and accent review.

Speech models: Meta AI, Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS), by Vineel Pratap and colleagues, 2023. Models are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 4.0. Virasat and these recordings are non-commercial. Meta does not endorse this project.

Virasat supplied the public instruction text, pronunciation spellings, synthesis and audio compression. No person's voice was cloned for this project.

Audio files are requested from this website. No private entries are sent to a voice service. Hosting logs can include your IP address and requested files. Browser storage keeps a bounded collection of public recordings for reuse; use Reading & listening to remove saved audio.
